NETWORK.NAME: BN_05_Continuing_Antipsychotic_Treatment
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_question=What supports maintenance antipsychotic treatment review after symptom improvement in schizophrenia?
source_locator=STATEMENT 5; Implementation; Benefits; Harms; Patient Preferences
population=Proposed adult schizophrenia maintenance-review population; diagnostic gate is not a diagnostic classifier
setting=Clinician-led maintenance review; local care setting requires agreement
time_horizon=Review flags: current encounter; proposed outcomes: 12 months after review, modeler assumption
parameter_policy=Missing priors and clinical CPTs omitted; no invented probabilities
missingness_policy=Absent evidence stays unobserved; no unknown disease state
table_order=Child varies fastest; last GIVEN parent next; OUTCOME declaration order
causal_status=Proposed observational graph; treatment conditioning is not intervention
deployment_gate=Consumer must reject incomplete definitions; PROPERTY strings do not enforce this
scope=Continuation of an antipsychotic, not mandatory continuation of the same drug or dose; no doses, taper schedules, mortality estimates, utilities or optimized actions
